turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Leave us now, my son, and let your mother and I finish this talk alone. You have heard my mother's words, and you will remember them and be guided by them.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: May I get you some tea, honorable mother, to help you feel better?

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Yes, child, bring me tea, and let it be sweet tea, with sugar from the sugar cane. Wang Lung, tell the maid to bring you a cup too.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me, I will take care of myself. I will find a good wife and provide for our family, just as Father has always taught me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not worried about you, my son. But I am worried about your marriage, and who will be worthy of you. You must not settle for just anyone.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will choose a wife who will make you proud, Mother. I promise to find someone who will be a good daughter-in-law to you and a helpmate to me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not worry about me, my son. I have always taught you to be strong and independent, and I have no doubt you will make a good choice for a wife. You will find someone who will make both your mother and me proud.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will speak to the matchmaker in the village tomorrow, and I am sure she will find a suitable wife for me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But what of the cost of the marriage, my son? Will you be able to afford the gifts and the dowry?

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not worry about the cost, my son. We will use the rice we saved from the good harvest last year to pay for the dowry and gifts.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will be careful with the rice, my son, for it is the only thing we have to fall back on now. I will make sure that the gifts and dowry are not too extravagant, for we must think of the future.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I'll go and start preparing the house for the matchmaker's visit, if it's not too much trouble, sir. I'll make sure everything is clean and in order.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will go with the maid to prepare the house, my son. I want to make sure everything is perfect for the matchmaker.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Shall I also start preparing the bride's room, ma'am? I'll make sure to arrange the bedding and curtains in the proper way.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, I am old and tired, but I will not rest until your marriage is arranged and you are settled. I want to see you happy, with a good wife and a home of your own.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about the matchmaker's visit, I am sure everything will be fine. I will take care of the rice and the household, you should rest and take care of yourself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not rest, my son. I have worked hard to provide for you and your family, and now it is time for you to have a good life.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My son, I have worked hard to provide for our family, but I am not sure how much longer I can keep everything together with O-lan's health failing

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I know my health is failing, but I must see this through. I want to know that our son is settled and happy, it is all I have to give him before I go.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my love, do not exhaust yourself with worry. I will take care of the matchmaker's visit and our son's future, you must rest and let me care for you.
